summary: Iter 11 - Tested (a) auto-create tipo from mold form and (b) molde+tipo filters on Reportes screen + exports. Backend 4/4 pytest passed (admin verify, auto-register tipo on POST /api/molds, /api/report/molds filters by molde/tipo/__none__, /api/report/molds/export accepts filters and returns valid PDF/XLSX). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; created QA-UI-M01 with a NEW tipo 'QATipoUI11' via mold-form-tipo datalist input - mold card created AND tipo chip auto-appeared in Tipos catalog AND appeared in datalist options. Created a second mold (QA-UI-M01-B) selecting the existing tipo - success. On Reportes: report-filter-molde and report-filter-tipo dropdowns present and populated (QA_MOLD & QA_TIPO shown as options); selecting 'Sin molde' updated summary to '0 con molde'; selecting QA tipo showed 'Sin paneles' empty state (no panels tagged, expected); with molde+tipo filters set, Export PDF and Export Excel triggered downloads whose URLs contained both molde=QA-UI-M01 and tipo=QATipoUI11 query params - confirmed exports respect active filters. Clean up done via API (both molds + tipo deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: ReportsPage.exportReport builds URL by string concatenation with encodeURIComponent only on molde/tipo but not on facade. Facade is currently constrained to known keys so safe, but consistent encoding would be safer.

save_mold auto-registers tipo unconditionally in db.tipos; if a user edits a mold and re-types the tipo with different casing/whitespace, a duplicate-like tipo could be created. Consider normalizing/case-insensitive match before insert.
MoldsPage still ~430 lines - extraction of MoldForm to its own file recommended (repeat note from iter10).
seed_data_creation: Temporary QA-UI-M01, QA-UI-M01-B molds and QATipoUI11 tipo created during UI test. All cleaned up via DELETE /api/molds/{name} and DELETE /api/tipos/{name}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter11 both features (auto-register tipo from mold form + molde/tipo filters on Reportes with export support) verified end-to-end. Regression test file at /app/backend/tests/test_molds_tipo_filters.py can be reused. Note: FACADE_FILTERS keys are 'all', 'Norte', 'Sur', 'Este', 'Oeste' (not single letters) - use data-testid=report-facade-Norte etc if targeting facade chips.
